units.rawText: Now that I think about it, I haven't gone out "hunting" for a while now. Hehehe, I hope my laziness doesn't displease you.

units.rawText: After all, I need to keep a close eye on you and look for a chance to slit your throat with my Mistelteinn. But thanks to the Dolls watching you around the clock, I haven't had any chances to do that at all.

units.rawText: ...So you already saw through me. Well, it's true that I had several chances in the past, but I decided not to follow through after careful though. After all, killing you would only give me a moment's enjoyment, which is nothing compared to the surprises that you constantly inflict on me by living.
